name: virki
description: Virki identity, authentication, security, project access, and audit gateway.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n public,hub,issuer -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev --workspace @virki/public-site" "npm run dev --workspace @virki/hub" "npm run start --workspace @virki/issuer"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @virki/public-site && npm run build --workspace @virki/hub
